Passive promotion now matches equivalent mixed traces by skill set, not exact fingerprint.

**Root cause:** `get_active_candidate_by_fingerprint` required an exact match on step order and arg keys. Equivalent `calendar.list_events` + `system.routing` traces with flipped order or different optional args (e.g. `start_date`/`end_date` vs `range`) got different fingerprints and created duplicate candidates instead of promoting.
